name: Pistol Squat
steps: Stand tall on one leg with your arms extended forward for counterbalance and lift your free leg straight out in front of you.
Brace your core, keep your standing foot flat on the floor, and slowly sit your hips back and down on your working leg.
Descend as deep as your ankle and hip mobility allow while keeping your extended heel elevated off the floor.
Drive firmly through your entire standing foot to return upright, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep your standing heel planted flat on the ground rather than rocking onto your toes.
Guide your working knee in line with your toes so it does not cave inward during the ascent.
